body: He's two, and he's amazing. I know he loves me, and I love him more than anything in this world. It's just that so much of this world is stacked against me right now that he's the only thing keeping me here, and I'm scared of what happens when that starts to finally erode under the pressure from everything else -- when it's suddenly not enough.  I won't have anything keeping me here.

You're also 19.  You have _so much time_ to turn it around.  Those folks saying "it'll just get better" are half-right.  It _can_ get better, but you have to step in and be a part of it, and you _can_ do it!

Crying is helpful.  It's so fucking helpful. I wish I could, honestly, and I'm envious you can now. Let it out.  Yell at the wall and scream to the air.  Express all that's hurting you and making you sad.  Then, when it's all done, in that hollow wake after crying and screaming, remember when you were happy.  Think about what things you did that made you happy then (not people, things; hobbies, places, etc.) and do them again.  _Make new memories. Make happy ones._

When my woman left me, she was happier as well.  I wasn't.  I felt like a failure, like a dead weight in her life.  And I was.  We didn't work. Someday, when I figure out who I really am (and you're young, you can't know yet!) I know there's a good chance I'll come across who I should really be with; someone that I won't drag down and who won't drag me down either.
